text:
Served: two glasses of orange juice (about 250 ml each, 110 kcal each, 220 kcal total), a peaches-and-cream yogurt (120 g, about 120 kcal), one fried egg (about 90 kcal) and a medium banana (about 105 kcal). Total served is about 535 kcal.

Leftover: a little juice remains in each glass (about 10 kcal) and a small amount of yogurt is left on the lid (about 5 kcal). The banana peel is inedible and not counted. Total leftover is about 15 kcal.

Eaten: 535 − 15 = 520 kcal.

- Protein: juice ~3.5 g + yogurt ~5 g + egg ~6.3 g + banana ~1.3 g ≈ 16 g.
- Carbohydrate: juice ~48 g + yogurt ~18 g + banana ~27 g ≈ 93 g.
- Fat: juice ~0.5 g + yogurt ~3.5 g + egg ~7 g + banana ~0.4 g ≈ 11 g.
